messages.text: Hi. I was just wondering, would you guys ship from Canada? I am in Canada but worried about customs if coming from the US

Yes. Orders to a Canadian address ship from our Canadian warehouse in Brampton, Ontario, so the parcel never crosses a border and there are no customs or import duties to pay on delivery. In the rare case a unit has to come from another warehouse, we send it with duties prepaid at no cost to you.

Prices are in USD, and any sales tax that applies is added at checkout. The Harlo B30 you're looking at is a Batch 5 pre-order and ships November 30, 2026.

Is there anything about the B30 itself I can help with?
